title: Home V2, compact navigation and operational Client 360

decisions.permissions: No role grants changed; new entitlements permissions are granted only where the current matrix already authorizes them.
decisions.catalogPrice: Price and due date are captured manually because the current plan catalog has no sale price.
decisions.rights: The assignment records the frozen plan version and rights; it does not consume or reserve entitlements.
decisions.activityFeed: Omitted until there is a safe cross-module read model; no synthetic activity is shown.
decisions.scopeGuard: No 2jfitnessapp changes, no duplicated Training/Health, no recurring charge automation, no auto-merge.

finalCorrection.finding: A quota sale used a new idempotency key for every submit, so a retry after a lost response could create duplicate economic records.
finalCorrection.behavior: Same logical sale retries reuse the same key and payload. The key rotates for a changed client/payload, and is cleared on confirmed success, explicit cancel/close/reset, or a new sale.
